title: Clipping versus Suturing the Stapleline during Sleeve Gastrectomy- a randomised controlled trial
summary: The effect of over-sewing the stapler line during sleeve gastrectomy should be compared with clipping the stapler line. For this purpose, the postoperative bleeding rate, swallowing difficulties, the length of hospital stay, the duration of the operation and patient satisfaction are examined in more detail.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• BMI ≥ 35 with indication for sleeve gastrectomy
• Sufficient knowledge of the German language to understand the Enlightenment and
to be taken into account when making the decision
• Capacity to consent
• Follow-up care capability, so that it is possible to attend follow-up appointments after 14 days and 6 months postoperatively
Exclusion criteria:
• Previous operations in the upper GI tract
• Serious previous illnesses (e.g. kidney failure)
• Pregnancy or breastfeeding
• Lack of consent
• Inability to attend follow-up appointments
• Lack of command of the German language
• Contraindications to either reinforcement method
